items.name: Clock H-Tree
items.depicts: A symmetrical blue and pale-cyan H-tree clock distribution network branching into four terminal bars.

items.name: NAND Gate
items.depicts: A blue-bordered logic gate with two input leads on the left, a dark body, and an inversion bubble on the right.

items.name: D Flip-Flop
items.depicts: A tall dark rectangular flip-flop cell with a pale-cyan border, a clock triangle at the bottom left, and data leads.

items.name: Timing Waveform
items.depicts: A dark-blue framed white timing-diagram window displaying pale-cyan square-wave pulse segments.

items.name: Multiplexer
items.depicts: A bright-blue trapezoidal multiplexer symbol tapering from left to right.

items.name: Binary Adder
items.depicts: A blue-framed dark block containing a pale-cyan plus sign.

items.name: Clock Rail
items.depicts: Two parallel horizontal clock rails, one pale cyan and one dark navy, in an animated 18x7 strip.

items.name: Gate Scuttler
items.depicts: A tiny grey-and-black pixelated critter that scuttles along the RTL logic grid.
